thread:
release-bot: Deploy window open for convo-router v2.5.0. Feature flag plan: `convrouter.v2.tilt` 0% -> 2% -> 12% over 30m. Change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Paging @maria @dean for monitoring.

maria: ack. I'll watch p50/p95, 5xx, and routing success ratio. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/convo-router/v2.5.0

dean: request: start at 1% not 2%, and add auto-pin if 5xx >1.5% for 4m OR p95 +250ms. Pin target v2.4.8.

release-bot: Plan updated: start 1% -> hold -> 2% -> 12%. Auto-pin conditions noted.

ops-bot: preflight OK: infra healthy, GPU headroom 31%, db replica lag 0.2s. Alerts armed to DM @dean on sustained errors.

olivia: toggling to 1% now:
```
/redwood flag set --name convrouter.v2.tilt --pct 1 --who olivia --note "step1 gentle"
```

maria: metrics at 1% after 6m: p95 baseline 195ms -> 205ms, 5xx steady 0.35%. holding.

release-bot: advancing to 2% as scheduled.

maria: after advance to 2% p95 -> 260ms, 5xx increased to 1.9% at 01:22. paging @dean.

dean: investigating traces t-900 and t-905. Looks like a downstream cache serialization failure. Manually pinning to v2.4.8 to stop ramp:
```
/release pin --service convo-router --version v2.4.8 --who dean --reason "error spike during ramp"
```

release-bot: Manual pin recorded at 8712345728 by dean. Rolling cohorts back to v2.4.8; draining v2.5.0 nodes. Posting rollback note to #release-notes: "v2.5.0 tilt ramp halted at 2% due to elevated 5xx; pinned to v2.4.8 while infra investigates."

olivia: filing bug with traces and sample inputs; assigning infra-cache team and model-eval.

ops-bot: recommendation: block reattempt until cache fix + 24h soak on staging. Also propose next ramp sequence: 0.5% -> 1.5% -> 8% with heavy-quant disabled until 1.5%.

maria: acknowledged. updating release ticket and notes. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
